title: アドバンスト機能化学
subtitle: Advanced Functional Chemistry
keywords: Biomolecular Functions 2.Analytical Techniques and Functions of Nanomaterials 3.Functional Polymer Materials 4.Thin Film Formation Technology 5.Fluorescent Materials and Optical Devices
educationalGoal: Experts in each field lecture in omnibus format. You Learn knowledge about biomolecular function, analytical techniques and functions of nanomaterials, functional polymer material, thin film formation technology, and fluorescent materials and optical devices. Comcequently, you cultivate the ability to design new substance. You also develop the ability to understand the chemical nature of the resource and energy issues.
advice: 1. Structural features and functions of biomolecules and bio-functional materials 2. Analytical techniques and functions of nanomaterials 3. requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to acquire knowledge of basic matters of inorganic chemistry, analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, organic chemistry, polymer chemistry and biochemistry.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the structural features and functions of biomolecules.
Be able to understand and explain advanced analytical techniques of nanomaterials
Be able to understand and explain advanced knowledge of organic polymer chemistry
Be able to understand and explain advanced thin film formation technology
Be able to understand and explain advanced fluorescent materials and optical devices
